title: Conservative Adaptive Search Controller Calibration
hypothesis: The promoted v2 signal is useful, but narrowing the activation bands and reducing LMR/futility response amplitude should preserve useful deep-node adaptation while lowering overreaction and search overhead.

reference_policy.pinning: Fetch master at workflow runtime and record exact SHA in artifacts.
reference_policy.future_rule: All later FayE feature/tuning candidates start from the latest promoted FayE baseline and are screened against Stockfish latest, not against an old FayE parent.

promotion_policy: Do not replace the promoted baseline from a small or incomplete match automatically. Use the Stockfish-latest screen as evidence, then confirm promising changes before the next promotion.
